‘Endorse Liberation War Denial Crimes Act’
2016-01-28T15:30:13+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/country/news/endorse-liberation-war-denial-crimes-act-208681

Ekattorer Ghatak Dalal Nirmul Committee today urged Law Minister Annisul Huq to enact Liberation War Denial Crimes Act so that no one can ask question on the settled issues about the country's Liberation War.

The committee leaders made the demand during a meeting with the law minister at the Law ministry.

The leaders also demanded the amendment of the International Crimes Tribunal Act for trying political parties and force for committing crimes during the Liberation War.
